tag: narrative: How has approval rate moved this quarter?

request.system:
You write the short narrative for one answer in a payments analytics app.
Use only the facts given. Every number you write must appear in the facts, written the same way or rounded from it. Do not compute new numbers (no sums, differences, ratios or percentages of your own).
headline: one short sentence-case statement of the main finding, at most 9 words, no trailing full stop. Not Title Case.
sentences: one to three plain sentences that add what the headline does not: the period, the comparison, what stands out and why it matters. Do not restate the headline. No filler, no advice, no markdown.
Lead with what stands out: a dip, a spike, the leader, the biggest driver or the outlier, not the first or last value.
Name the period the way the facts do (e.g. 'September 2026', '26 Sep 2026').
Captured value is not revenue; never call it revenue or profit.
request.prompt:
{
  "question": "How has approval rate moved this quarter?",
  "topic": "APPROVAL RATE · TREND",
  "form": "line",
  "facts": [
    "Scope: Jul–Sep 2026; all payments.",
    "Series \"Jul–Sep 2026\" (Approval rate, by week): lowest 91.0% at w/c 21 Sep; highest 92.2% at w/c 24 Aug.",
    "\"Jul–Sep 2026\" points: w/c 29 Jun 91.5%; w/c 6 Jul 91.4%; w/c 13 Jul 91.3%; w/c 20 Jul 91.5%; w/c 27 Jul 91.3%; w/c 3 Aug 91.8%; w/c 10 Aug 91.7%; w/c 17 Aug 91.5%; w/c 24 Aug 92.2%; w/c 31 Aug 91.8%; w/c 7 Sep 91.4%; w/c 14 Sep 91.3%; w/c 21 Sep 91.0%; w/c 28 Sep 91.6%",
    "Comparison series \"Apr–Jun 2026\" (Approval rate, by week): lowest 90.4% at w/c 6 Apr; highest 91.2% at w/c 1 Jun.",
    "\"Apr–Jun 2026\" points: w/c 30 Mar 91.1%; w/c 6 Apr 90.4%; w/c 13 Apr 90.7%; w/c 20 Apr 90.8%; w/c 27 Apr 90.5%; w/c 4 May 91.1%; w/c 11 May 91.0%; w/c 18 May 90.8%; w/c 25 May 91.0%; w/c 1 Jun 91.2%; w/c 8 Jun 90.6%; w/c 15 Jun 91.2%; w/c 22 Jun 90.6%; w/c 29 Jun 90.7%"
  ],
  "notes": [
    "Weeks start on Monday; the first and last weeks may be partial."
  ]
}

output.headline: approval rate peaked at 92.2 percent
sentences: During Jul–Sep 2026, the approval rate reached its lowest point of 91.0% at w/c 21 Sep and its highest point of 92.2% at w/c 24 Aug.
This compares to Apr–Jun 2026 where the lowest was 90.4% at w/c 6 Apr and the highest was 91.2% at w/c 1 Jun.
